import json,sys
from pathlib import Path
import mule_detection
from mule_detection.domain.contracts.registry import CONTRACTS, resolve_contract
assert Path(mule_detection.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(Path(sys.prefix).resolve())
fixtures=json.loads(Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text())
assert len(CONTRACTS)==15 and set(CONTRACTS)==set(fixtures)
for version,payload in fixtures.items():
    model=resolve_contract(version,payload)
    assert resolve_contract(version,model.model_dump_json())==model
print(json.dumps({'status':'PASSED','installed_contracts':len(CONTRACTS),'synthetic_roundtrips':len(fixtures),'package_file':mule_detection.__file__}))
